background.title: Russo-Ukrainian war
background.extract: The Russo-Ukrainian war began in February 2014 and is ongoing. Following Ukraine's Revolution of Dignity, Russia occupied Crimea and annexed it from Ukraine. It then supported Russian separatist armed groups who started a war in the eastern Donbas region against Ukraine's military. In 2018, Ukraine declared the region to be occupied by Russia. The first eight years of conflict also involved naval incidents and cyberwarfare. In February 2022, Russia launched a full-scale invasion of Ukraine and began occupying more of the country, starting the current phase of the war, the largest conflict in Europe since World War II. The war has resulted in a refugee crisis and hundreds of thousands of deaths.

headlines.excerpt: Two drones were detected in Moldovan airspace on Saturday, October 31, amid a massive Russian attack on Ukraine.

headlines.title: First rounds of Ukraine talks should take place in trilateral format — Kremlin aide
headlines.excerpt: Representatives from Europe may also be present at the negotiating table, but the process must begin in a trilateral format, Yury Ushakov said

headlines.title: Europe must change in approach to Russia to be part of Ukraine talks — Kremlin
headlines.excerpt: Europe’s current stance, which calls for defeating Russia, makes dialogue with Russia impossible, Dmitry Peskov said

headlines.title: Russia launches nearly 2,000 attack drones, over 1,500 guided bombs, 44 missiles at Ukraine in one week – Zelensky
headlines.excerpt: Russia launched 1,940 attack drones, more than 1,580 guided aerial bombs and 44 missiles of various types, including 36 ballistic missiles, at Ukraine over the past week.

headlines.title: Putin never refused to talk with Zelensky, who is free to come to Moscow — Kremlin aide
headlines.excerpt: Yury Ushakov emphasized that if Vladimir Zelensky wants to speak with the Russian leader in person, he is welcome to visit Moscow

headlines.title: Ukraine loses up to 1,175 servicemen in special op zone over past 24 hours — top brass
headlines.excerpt: Russian servicemen struck transport and energy infrastructure facilities used by the Ukrainian military, as well as drone storage and launch sites, the Defense Ministry said

headlines.title: Russian forces stepping up efforts to expand control in northern Kharkiv region, border guards say
headlines.excerpt: Russian troops are making the strongest efforts to expand their area of control in the northern Kharkiv region. In the Chernihiv region, however, they currently lack sufficient forces to launch such attacks.

headlines.title: Russian drone attacks damage energy facilities in Kyiv region, injure woman
headlines.excerpt: Russian drones attacked the Kyiv region over the course of the day, with damage reported in six districts and a woman injured.

headlines.title: Denmark involved in Ukraine conflict, serving as its ‘logistical base’ — ambassador
headlines.excerpt: Vladimir Barbin stressed that Copenhagen is providing "a substantial amount of grant-based military aid to the Kiev regime," which has already exceeded 10.5 billion euros

headlines.title: Kiev forced to introduce emergency power outages
headlines.excerpt: The cause is damage to the capital’s power grid, the DTEK energy company said

headlines.title: Ukraine loses 1.9% of its GDP since beginning of year due to explosions
headlines.excerpt: Over the past few months, explosions have occurred in warehouses and at facilities in the military-industrial and energy sectors, as well as at port infrastructure sites and data centers serving the Ukrainian armed forces

headlines.title: Russia's war casualty toll in Ukraine up by 2,100 over past day
headlines.excerpt: The total combat losses of Russian forces in the war against Ukraine from February 24, 2022, to November 1, 2026, have reached approximately 1,590,270 personnel, including 2,100 troops killed or wounded over the past 24 hours.

headlines.title: Air defense neutralizes 371 of 433 Russian drones launched against Ukraine overnight
headlines.excerpt: Ukraine's air defense forces neutralized 371 out of the 433 drones used by Russian troops to attack Ukraine since the evening of October 31.

headlines.title: Russian forces strike Zaporizhzhia region 699 times in past 24 hours, six injured
headlines.excerpt: Russian troops launched 699 attacks on 55 settlements in the Zaporizhzhia region over the past 24 hours. Six people were injured in enemy attacks on the Zaporizhzhia district.

headlines.title: Trump says he will invite Zelensky to G20 summit
headlines.excerpt: U.S. President Donald Trump has said that he will invite Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky to the G20 summit, which will be held in Miami in mid-December.

headlines.title: Zelensky thanks Melania Trump for mediation in securing ceasefire in Oleshky
headlines.excerpt: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has thanked U.S. First Lady Melania Trump for her mediation in arranging a ceasefire in the temporarily occupied city of Oleshky and said Ukraine would support the continuation of the initiative.

headlines.title: Trump says peace deal between Ukraine and Russia getting closer
headlines.excerpt: U.S. President Donald Trump has once again said that the United States is bringing an agreement to end the war in Ukraine closer.

headlines.title: Zelensky meets with Ecumenical Patriarch Bartholomew
headlines.excerpt: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky, during a meeting with Ecumenical Patriarch Bartholomew, congratulated him on the 35th anniversary of his enthronement, which will be marked on November 2.

headlines.title: Zelensky awards 733 service members, including 255 posthumously
headlines.excerpt: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has awarded state honors to 733 service members, including 255 posthumously.

headlines.title: Heroin and cocaine not produced in Ukraine – police
headlines.excerpt: Heroin and cocaine are not manufactured in Ukraine, the National Police of Ukraine has said.

headlines.title: Ukraine and NATO to deepen cooperation on innovative technologies
headlines.excerpt: Deputy Minister of Defense of Ukraine Sergiy Boyev and representatives of NATO’s Defense Innovation Accelerator for the North Atlantic (DIANA) signed a memorandum of understanding to deepen cooperation in the joint development, testing and adoption of innovative technologies.

headlines.title: Zelensky outlines possible dates for trilateral meeting between Ukraine, US, Russia
headlines.excerpt: Technical-level trilateral talks between Ukraine, the United States and Russia could take place in Abu Dhabi on November 6-10, although the exact date and venue have not yet been finalized.

headlines.title: US not claiming negotiated Ukraine settlement anywhere close — Rubio
headlines.excerpt: US Secretary of State said that at a press conference following the G20 foreign ministers’ meeting in Atlanta, Georgia

headlines.title: Ukrainian evacuees reunite with family after years trapped in Russia-occupied city
headlines.excerpt: Oleshky residents had been without food, water and electricity, with many resorting to cooking garden weeds to survive.

headlines.title: Finnish president says he, Norwegian PM called Putin at Kiev’s request
headlines.excerpt: Alexander Stubb also noted, that other European countries "were aware of the contents" of the conversation

headlines.title: Ukraine faces complicated situation with power supplies, says Zelensky
headlines.excerpt: He reported about strikes delivered against thermal power plants in Kiev, Dnepropetrovsk and Kharkov

headlines.title: Ukraine: Oleshky ceasefire offers ‘hope’ for civilians as attacks on aid vehicles continue
headlines.excerpt: Each day the ceasefire in Oleshky holds means hope for civilians in the city, the UN’s top humanitarian official said, stressing that those wishing to leave must be able to do so safely and voluntarily.

headlines.title: Cameroon families demand return of relatives from Ukraine
headlines.excerpt: In Cameroon, the “Bring Back Our Sons and Brothers” collective organised a peaceful march on Wednesday, 28 October, to the Russian embassy. They are calling on Russia and the Cameroonian government to work together to dismantle networks recruiting Cameroonians clandestinely into…

headlines.title: Ukraine: Russian strike kills two teenage girls in Chernihiv
headlines.excerpt: A Russian strike on Chernihiv killed two 15-year-old girls and injured 25 people, local officials say. Meanwhile, a US-brokered ceasefire in southern Ukraine is allowing demining work aimed at opening humanitarian routes.

headlines.title: Russia drone strike on Ukrainian railway station kills 13
headlines.excerpt: The UN’s top humanitarian official in Ukraine on Thursday condemned a Russian drone attack on the city of Dnipro that killed at least 13 civilians and injured 10 others at its main railway station.

headlines.title: World News in Brief: ‘No safe place in Ukraine’, IAEA calls for Iran nuclear inspections, Kenya hosts thousands of Ethiopians fleeing clashes
headlines.excerpt: The UN refugee agency (UNHCR) on Tuesday urged continued international support for Ukraine’s population as Russian airstrikes intensify and humanitarian needs grow in advance of another bitterly cold winter.

headlines.title: Ukraine: Investigators find Russia committed war crimes by targeting civilians
headlines.excerpt: Top human rights experts investigating Russia’s full-scale invasion of Ukraine said on Monday that the Russian authorities had committed war crimes and crimes against humanity by attacking civilians and vital energy infrastructure, among other violations of international…
